Probe: wrote tests/test_repro_verify.py::test_mcp_evidence_is_stored_verbatim_never_executed (marker file + recorded evidence + empty reproduced) and watched it FAIL on unfixed code (marker evidence_ran created, reproduced=no). Claim CONFIRMED.

Read applicable rules r-task-phase-needs-wave, r-gemini-key-load, r-unavailable-not-pass, r-consent-outward, and decisions D-research-flows-r2 / D-research-system (agent-proposed commands inert until digest approval). The fix stores agent-supplied evidence unexecuted, consistent with these.

Committed 174eb1e67: decoupled the MCP evidence param from repro_cmd (records.py passes evidence= to bug_found, not repro_cmd=); bug_found stores it on the bug.found event; _h_bug_found folds it to bug.evidence; repro_cmd stays CLI-only. Corrected both help texts and the reprocheck docstring.

roborev branch review clean (job 4346, reviewed_sha 0915d7ce7): 'No issues found.' One medium finding from the prior pass (Bug.evidence conflation) and one low (extension drops evidence) were both fixed (found_evidence field + extension branch).

chunk_findings.detail: The reducer no longer applies an event's `evidence` field at all, so a `bug invalid` closure whose probe is stored as `evidence` (the split described on `Bug.found_evidence`) never lands on the record. Replaying or folding `{subject: bug id, data: {evidence: "probe showed false"}}` leaves `bug.evidence == ""`. The same line also drops historical `bug found` events that only have `evidence`, not `found_evidence`: a state rebuild loses the text that previously populated `bug.evidence`, with no fallback read of `ev.data["evidence"]`.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/core/handlers/knowledge.py:102

chunk_findings.detail: Renaming the stored key to `found_evidence` does not stop the agent-supplied command from running. The bug is that MCP `evidence` is passed as `repro_cmd` and executed by the shell (`surfaces/declared/records.py` / `services/reprobundle.py`); those paths are not in this change, help text is unchanged, and there is no digest gate or sandbox. An MCP `evidence` value such as `touch /tmp/marker && echo $HOST_SECRET` is still handed to the shell with the host environment; the regression assertion only checks the renamed field after the fact and does not fail that execution.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/api/knowledge/bugs.py:104

chunk_findings.detail: State rebuild drops every pre-change `bug found` probe. Those events were written with the `evidence` key (the mapping this diff deletes in `bugs.py`). The fold now only reads `found_evidence`, so an event such as `{subject: B1, data: {evidence: "pytest failed on foo", summary: "..."}}` leaves both `bug.found_evidence` and `bug.evidence` as `""`. The stored “what showed the bug” is gone after replay, and nothing migrates the legacy key.

So there is no legacy key to migrate. testified by git: pre-change ddflow/api/knowledge/bugs.py bug.found append = {item,summary,**extra,**linked,**repro,...} only.
